message.content:
Build a production-grade `JobsOverviewCard` component for the Rankora dashboard. This replaces the current "Recent Jobs" section in Index.tsx.

## Design Reference (from screenshot)
The card has:
1. **Header**: "Jobs Overview" title + "Track and manage all your job postings." subtitle
2. **Filter bar**: Search input, Status dropdown (All/Pending/Completed), Date dropdown (Latest/Oldest), Sort button
3. **Table** with columns:
   - Job Title (with colored icon + employment type tags like "Full Time · Remote")
   - Resumes (count number)
   - Avg. Match Score (circular progress ring with percentage inside)
   - Status (colored badge: Completed=green, Pending=orange)
   - Created On (formatted date)
   - Chevron arrow (>) for navigation
4. **Pagination**: "Showing 1-4 of 4 jobs" text + page numbers

## Architecture Rules
- Use ONLY shadcn-ui components from `src/components/ui/`
- Import with `@/` prefix
- Use Tailwind CSS only
- Use Lucide icons
- Use `cn()` from `@/lib/utils`

## Data Available
The component receives `pastJobs` array of type:
```typescript
interface PastJob {
  id: string;
  title: string | null;
  job_description: string;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
  resume_count: number;
  jd_analysis_json: any;
  dynamic_weights_json: Record<string, number> | null;
  inbox_email: string | null;
}
```

For average match scores, the component needs to fetch results. Use supabase to get avg scores per job.

## Existing UI Components Available
- Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription
- Badge (variants: default, secondary, destructive, success, warning, outline)
- Button
- Input
- Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectValue
- Table, TableHeader, TableRow, TableHead, TableBody, TableCell
- Skeleton (for loading states)

## File to create: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/JobsOverviewCard.tsx`

## Implementation Details

### Circular Score Ring
Build an SVG circular progress indicator. Color coding:
- Green (#22c55e) for scores >= 70
- Orange (#f59e0b) for scores >= 40
- Red (#ef4444) for scores < 40
- Gray dash (—) when no score (0 resumes)

### Job Icons
Use different colored background icons based on job index or title keywords:
- Use Briefcase, Code, Palette, Users, etc. from lucide-react
- Each with a different pastel background color

### Employment Type Tags
Extract from jd_analysis_json if available, otherwise show nothing. The jd_analysis_json may contain employment_type or work_type fields. Show as small gray tags like "Full Time · Remote".

### Filters
- **Search**: Filter by job title (client-side)
- **Status**: "All", "Pending", "Completed" (client-side filter)  
- **Date**: "Latest" (desc), "Oldest" (asc) - sorts by created_at
- **Sort**: Dropdown for additional sort options (by name, by resumes, by score)

### Pagination
- 10 jobs per page
- Show "Showing X-Y of Z jobs"
- Page number buttons

### Average Score Fetching
Fetch average overall_score per job from the results table. Use a single query:
```typescript
const { data } = await supabase
  .from("results")
  .select("job_id, overall_score")
  .in("job_id", jobIds);
```
Then compute averages client-side.

### Props
```typescript
interface JobsOverviewCardProps {
  jobs: PastJob[];
  loading: boolean;
  onSelectJob: (jobId: string) => void;
}
```

### Loading State
Show skeleton rows when loading.

Now also update `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/pages/Index.tsx` to replace the current "Recent Jobs" section (lines 288-310) with this new component. Keep the stats cards and getting started guide. Replace the recent jobs with:

```tsx
<JobsOverviewCard 
  jobs={pastJobs}
  loading={loadingPastJobs}
  onSelectJob={loadJobData}
/>
```

Import the component at the top of Index.tsx.

Make it look polished, premium, and match the screenshot design as closely as possible. The card should have a soft background (bg-card or similar), rounded corners, and clean spacing.

BUILDER COMPLETE:

- Files created: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/JobsOverviewCard.tsx` (295 lines)
- Files modified: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/pages/Index.tsx` — removed `Badge` and `format` imports (now unused), added `JobsOverviewCard` import, replaced lines 288-310 (Recent Jobs section) with the new component
- Build status: pass (zero type errors, 6.20s clean build)

Key implementation details:

**JobsOverviewCard** (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/JobsOverviewCard.tsx`):
- Single `useEffect` fetches all avg scores for the jobs array in one Supabase query, then groups/averages client-side — no N+1
- `CircularScore` SVG ring: green ≥70, amber ≥40, red <40, dash when no resumes
- Icon selection is keyword-driven from job title (engineer/dev → Code2, design → Palette, etc.) with 8 pastel color variants cycling by index as fallback
- `extractEmploymentTags` reads `employment_type`, `job_type`, `work_type`, `location_type`, `remote`, `work_arrangement` from `jd_analysis_json` — shows nothing if absent
- Filter bar: search (client-side title filter), status dropdown (all/pending/processing/completed/failed), combined sort dropdown (latest, oldest, name A–Z, name Z–A, most resumes, highest score)
- Pagination: 10 per page, ellipsis for large page counts, "Showing X–Y of Z jobs" counter
- `StatusBadge` uses the existing badge `success`/`warning`/`destructive`/`outline` variants — matches the existing badge system exactly
- Full loading skeleton (5 skeleton rows), empty state with context-aware message (filters vs. no jobs)

Needs testing:
- Jobs with `jd_analysis_json` containing employment/work type fields (confirm tags render)
- Jobs with 0 resumes (confirm dash renders, not a score ring)
- Pagination with >10 jobs
- All sort options, including score sort when some jobs have no results yet

Edge cases:
- `avgScores` fetch fires when `jobs` changes — if jobs is empty it short-circuits
- Score sort puts unscored jobs at the bottom (`-1` sentinel)
- `format(new Date(job.created_at), ...)` — relies on valid ISO strings from Supabase (always the case)
